title: VooPoo Vinci S Pod Vape Kit
description: The VooPoo VINCI S Pod Vape Kit redefines the capabilities of a compact pod device, engineering exceptional endurance into a sleek, minimalist chassis. Constructed from lightweight yet highly durable aluminium alloy and polycarbonate, the device is designed to be both a reliable daily driver and a striking statement piece. The visual experience is enhanced by the dynamic "Luminous Palette" LED light display, providing clear, intuitive feedback on your device's status. The most significant advancement in the VINCI S is its integrated 2000mAh Ultra Endurance Lithium battery. This massive capacity is engineered to eliminate power anxiety, offering up to several days of intensive use—and potentially up to a week for lighter users—on a single charge. Supported by a highly capable chipset, the device outputs between 5W and 40W, providing a broad performance spectrum that caters equally to precise Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draws and expansive Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) vaping. The vaping experience is finely tuned via the stepless airflow adjustment slider, allowing for exact draw resistance calibration. The kit utilises the advanced VINCI S Cartridges, which integrate VooPoo's COSM CODE 2.0 technology. This innovation significantly upgrades leak resistance while delivering an exceptionally smooth and consistent flavour profile from the first puff to the last. Complete with a convenient top-side refill mechanism, the VINCI S provides a sophisticated, low-maintenance ecosystem. We recommend paring the pods in this kit with the following e-liquids: Voopoo Vinci S replacement pod 0.8ohm - Use Nic Salts E-Liquid Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen vape liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
